categories.main_business_segments: The company operates two primary business segments: (1) Amusement Equipment Manufacturing - designing, manufacturing, and installing large-scale amusement rides and virtual immersive entertainment projects; (2) Amusement Investment and Operations - investing in and operating amusement parks, theme parks, and entertainment venues. The company positions itself as a comprehensive cultural tourism service enterprise integrating equipment manufacturing with tourism operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses self-developed core technologies at domestic leading and international advanced levels across 13 major categories of large amusement rides and 8 series of virtual immersive projects. Manufacturing employs 'sales-driven production' model with customized product development, strict quality management systems, and advanced production processes. The company holds Class A special equipment production licenses, ISO9001 certification, and EU EN1090 certification, utilizing innovation in materials, design, and manufacturing techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include theme parks, amusement parks, cultural tourism attractions, commercial complexes, and science experience centers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products exported to nearly 50 countries and regions. Key markets include high-end domestic theme parks, international markets in Southeast Asia, Middle East, Latin America, and developed markets including Europe and North America.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Zhongshan, Gangkou, and Banfu districts. International presence includes subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Switzerland. The company has established marketing service channels in Southeast Asia, North America, and Latin America, with operations in multiple Chinese cities including Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Foshan, Zhanjiang, Changde, and Fuzhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in equipment design and manufacturing, midstream in component sourcing and assembly, and downstream in direct sales to end-users and project operation. The company maintains control over core manufacturing processes while outsourcing certain components and utilizing external cooperation for specific production needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a 'Manufacturing + Cultural Tourism' dual-wheel driving strategy with focus on: (1) Technology innovation in large amusement equipment and virtual reality/AI integration; (2) Product quality enhancement and import substitution; (3) International market expansion and global brand building; (4) Development of differentiated products for emerging markets; (5) Integration of virtual reality, artificial intelligence, and immersive technologies into products.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Direct sales of amusement equipment with progress-based payment structure (advance payment, progress payments during manufacturing, final payment upon delivery); (2) Equipment maintenance and upgrade services; (3) Amusement park investment and operations including ticket sales, merchandise sales, and management fees; (4) Consulting and planning services for cultural tourism projects; (5) Lease and rental income from operated venues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading domestic amusement equipment manufacturer and the first A-share listed company in the industry. It is the sole Chinese equipment supplier for international top-tier theme parks like Universal Studios. The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolio across multiple categories, competing against numerous smaller domestic competitors and international manufacturers. Market position strengthened by technology leadership, brand recognition, and full-service capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of 576.87 million yuan (down 21.88% YoY) and net profit of 7.35 million yuan (down 84.07% YoY), reflecting market cyclicality and product mix changes. Total assets reached 2.357 billion yuan (up 11.69% YoY). Operating cash flow improved significantly to 154.99 million yuan (up 654.68% YoY). The company maintains low asset-liability ratios and strong financial stability with substantial cash reserves of 748.12 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) Comprehensive product matrix across 13 major categories and 8 virtual immersive series, offering solutions competitors cannot match; (2) Superior cost-performance ratio compared to international competitors; (3) Advanced technology integration including VR, AI, and immersive experiences; (4) Full-service capabilities from design through operation; (5) Proven track record with international top-tier clients; (6) Commitment to safety, quality, and innovation; (7) Ability to provide customized solutions and rapid delivery for diverse market segments.
